offers_products.reason: Makes IV pumps, needlefree connectors, IV solutions, catheters, compounding automation and IV safety software for hospitals.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from devices, IV solutions and software; the Infusion Assessment Program is only supporting.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Website is for healthcare professionals only; hospitals and clinicians choose and buy the devices and IV solutions.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells IV pumps, consumables and IV solutions to hospitals, health systems and pharmacies, with contracted customers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most sales are repeat orders of disposable IV sets, connectors and IV solutions under hospital contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Hospitals need IV therapy and consumables for patient care regardless of the economy; pumps are less critical.

big_ticket.reason: Main sales are frequent consumables like IV solutions, connectors and tubing sets; pumps are occasional larger purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Manufacturer of medical devices and IV solutions; customers pay for goods and technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are hospital systems, group purchasing organizations and large health networks buying under contract.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs manufacturing plants, including an expanding Austin IV solutions plant and a joint venture, with warehousing for safety stock.
